title: Sentinel Task Engine State record
description: S4 State Machine Kernel task-state record (ML-DEVOS-RFC-016 / ML-DEVOS-AS-065 / D-050). Describes only a task's kernel-tracked lifecycle progress: current state, owner/lease, the unified revision fencing token, per-transition-class retry counts, a bounded state-change-provenance history, and a reference to the task's S3 Task Contract. It never grants authority, tool access, credentials, remote-resource access, merge approval, deployment approval, or risk acceptance (CORE-001, CORE-002) -- see the required `authority_disclaimer` field, whose value this schema fixes verbatim. This schema is descriptive/structural only; devos/state/lifecycle.mjs and devos/state/kernel.mjs implement the semantic transition/ownership/idempotency rules this file cannot express.

task_id.description: Stable identifier, reusing the same shape convention as S3's task_id (devos/contracts/task-contract.schema.json).

contract_ref.description: References an S3 Task Contract's task_id. The kernel never copies that contract's scope/claims/evidence fields -- it stores only this reference (ML-DEVOS-RFC-016 section G).

state.description: Exactly the frozen ML-DEVOS-ARCH-001 section 10 lifecycle plus the two additive terminal states FAILED and ABANDONED that D-050 explicitly adopted for this implementation.

owner.description: Current lease holder's actor identity, or null when unowned (including immediately after a designated handoff transition).

revision.description: The single unified fencing/optimistic-concurrency token. Increments by exactly 1 on every successful mutating operation (create/claim/renew/release/transition).

lease_expires_at.description: Epoch-millisecond lease expiry, or null when unowned.

retry_counts.description: Durable, bounded per-transition-class retry counters compared against the explicit S4 Task Policy retry ceiling (devos/state/task-policy.mjs) -- never against coordination/STATE.md.

idempotency_ledger.description: Per-operation-class map of idempotency-key -> {binding, result}, covering claim/renew/transition. release() is deliberately not ledgered here -- see TASK_STATE_KERNEL.md / kernel.mjs for its documented already-unowned no-op exception.

history.description: Bounded internal transition-provenance log (from/to/actor/timestamp/evidence-reference/revision). Strictly scoped to state-change provenance -- never raw command output, tool invocations, or cost/timing telemetry, which remain a future Run History store's domain (ML-DEVOS-ARCH-001 section 11).

authority_disclaimer.const: This Task Engine State record describes only the kernel's tracked lifecycle progress for a task already authorized elsewhere (its S3 Task Contract, referenced by contract_ref). It does not itself grant authority, tool access, credentials, remote-resource access, merge approval, deployment approval, or risk acceptance (CORE-001, CORE-002). A task reaching MERGED/DEPLOYED/VERIFIED in this record is a descriptive fact about kernel-tracked progress, not a merge/deployment/production authorization by itself.
authority_disclaimer.description: Fixed verbatim by `const`, mirroring S3's task-contract.schema.json authority_disclaimer convention, so no instance can soften, omit, or reword the non-authority boundary.
